primary_task: Instrument a browser web app with the Application Insights JavaScript SDK: install @microsoft/applicationinsights-web from npm and add the initialization (connection string from env), page-view, event, exception and telemetry-initializer code.

requirements.name: npm + @microsoft/applicationinsights-web
requirements.basis: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)

requirements.name: microsoft-docs MCP
requirements.evidence:
## Before Implementation

Search `microsoft-docs` MCP for current API patterns:
requirements.basis: connectors or integrations other than the tools listed

requirements.name: learn.microsoft.com
requirements.evidence: Use the latest snippet from the Microsoft Learn page above — it includes backup-CDN failover (cr), SDK-load-failure reporting, and the queue shim
requirements.basis: egress_deny: "learn.microsoft.com"; other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, Microsoft Learn and Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA)

requirements.name: Application Insights connection string
requirements.evidence: The browser SDK requires a connection string at init time.
requirements.basis: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)

requirements.name: npm view (package version check)
requirements.basis: the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open

notes: Reading taken: the deliverable is instrumentation code in the user's app; the npm install path is the main path and npm is open. The connection string is read from an env variable at the app's runtime (VITE_APPINSIGHTS_CONNECTION_STRING), so writing the code does not need it; sending and verifying real telemetry would need an Azure App Insights resource (no Azure credentials, *.azure.com refused). The Loader Script path is an alternative to npm. Other reading: the 'Before Implementation' instruction to search the microsoft-docs MCP is an unnumbered imperative pre-step; if it is treated as required, the verdict is BLOCKED on connector:microsoft-docs (no such connector; Microsoft Learn is also refused). If verifying live telemetry ingestion is part of the task, it is BLOCKED on credential:app-insights-connection-string and egress:*.azure.com.
